passage.title: A NEW HOBBY
passage.subtitle: Daniel's photography club
paragraphs: My name is Daniel, and I am sixteen years old. Last year, I moved to a new town with my family because my father got a new job. At first, I did not know many people, so I often stayed at home after school. One day, my classmate Ben invited me to join his photography club. I was not very interested in photography before, but I decided to try it.
The club meets every Wednesday afternoon at the community centre. We usually take pictures of buildings, people and nature. Our teacher also shows us how to use photo-editing software.
I have learned a lot since I joined the club. Now, I have many new friends, and I enjoy spending my free time outdoors. Next month, we are going to have a small photo exhibition at school.
